declarations.manualRationale: Partial native product catalog must retain known product order and mark missing products unavailable instead of inventing prices/availability; empty catalog length checks lack the partial-catalog merge case.

declarations.title: normalizes missing native entitlement fields fail closed
assertions: expect(services.entitlements.readOwnership()).resolves.toEqual({ doubleInfinityPoints: false, developerOptions: true, supporterCatGallery: false, })
declarations.manualRationale: Partial native entitlement object defaults absent fields false while preserving true developer ownership, unlike a complete all-false response.

declarations.title: installs a native termination handshake that checkpoints and shuts down
declarations.manualRationale: Installed termination callback must await checkpoint and shutdown and return success; lifecycle policy wiring does not invoke this host handshake.

declarations.title: routes same-device Unity purchase evidence only through a capable native host
declarations.manualRationale: Direct capable-host promotion asserts the entire evidence object is forwarded, including platform, path, hash and schema fields. The integrated migration case below only matches a subset of resulting evidence.

declarations.title: migrates a paid mobile Unity candidate whose one-use token binds every layer
assertions: expect(repository.migrateLegacyOnFirstLaunch()).resolves.toMatchObject({ status: 'migrated', source: { id: token, sourcePath: `unity-readonly:${token}`, provenance: { opaqueSourceIdentifier: token }, }, })
declarations.manualRationale: Builds a real repository over native composition and migrates token-bound paid Unity candidate, asserting token survives source-path/provenance and promotion exactly once. Direct promotion forwarding bypasses discovery and repository verification.

declarations.title: exposes %s achievement reporting and Settings UI through the native composition
declarations.manualRationale: Android/iOS achievement bridge must select correct provider, persist evidence, strip submitted facts to unlocked IDs and expose Settings show action; other host/store composition tests never invoke achievement methods.

declarations.title: waits for the second Infinity and a complete idle pause
declarations.manualRationale: One Infinity remains ineligible even after long idle; crossing two then waiting deadline minus one/exact deadline proves both progression gate and initial idle threshold.

declarations.title: restarts the idle pause after player input
declarations.manualRationale: Pointer input near expiry restarts the full idle interval. Progression publications and lifecycle events are separate signal sources and do not establish document input wiring.

declarations.title: treats every later Infinity as active play and waits again
declarations.manualRationale: An additional Infinity during an armed timer restarts inactivity; pointer input coverage cannot detect missing progress-event reset.

declarations.title: does not prompt while backgrounded and waits after resuming
declarations.manualRationale: Background suppresses an armed request through a long timer advance and active lifecycle requires a fresh idle period, unlike user-input-only inactivity.

declarations.title: cancels eligibility when a reset or import drops progression
declarations.manualRationale: Progression dropping to zero while armed cancels eligibility, guarding reset/import rollback rather than just postponing an eligible session.

declarations.title: treats an imported session as a new baseline without arming the prompt
declarations.manualRationale: A new session revision with high Infinity count establishes baseline without prompting, while a subsequent increment arms; same-session count changes do not cover import session identity.

declarations.title: makes at most one request in a running session
declarations.manualRationale: After a completed review request, later Infinity and keyboard input cannot trigger a second request; all other tests stop after the first request.

declarations.title: does not prompt merely because an experienced player opened the app
declarations.manualRationale: An experienced initial snapshot alone is not a new achievement event; only a later increase arms. The first test begins below the progression gate and would not detect startup prompting for veterans.

declarations.title: valid portable checkpoint takes precedence over Unity and retains lifecycle time
declarations.manualRationale: Prepared primary with dateQuitString and debugOptions proves lifecycle timestamp retention plus stripping imported developer entitlement; filesystem sync tests do not assert both trust-boundary fields.

declarations.title: conflicting valid local progress requires a choice and remains local when selected
declarations.manualRationale: Healthy primary conflicting with valid local data must invoke choose once and never commit when local wins; corrupt-backup conflict integration starts from a different preparation path.

declarations.title: invalid downloaded save blocks publication when no recovery exists
declarations.manualRationale: Damaged primary without available backups must block without commit or acknowledgment; successful backup recovery cannot establish the no-recovery fail-closed branch.

declarations.title: valid Cloud backup recovers a corrupt primary through preparation
declarations.manualRationale: Damaged primary followed by damaged then healthy backups verifies skip-and-recover ordering and exactly one commit. Filesystem future-backup coverage stops at unsupported formats instead of skipping damaged ones.

declarations.title: absent or unreadable Cloud allows local startup
declarations.manualRationale: Explicit null and rejected read both call local resolver; filesystem unreadable-path integration only covers read failure and also adds host publication disabling.

declarations.title: labels local browser builds as Dev
assertions: expect(resolveReleaseFooter({ target: 'browser', developmentBuild: true, source, })).resolves.toEqual({ platform: 'Dev', version: '4.1.5', build: 'local', })
declarations.manualRationale: Browser development flag selects Dev/local despite supplied version identity; production browser and Electron branches do not cover this target/flag combination.

declarations.title: labels production browser builds as Website
assertions: expect(resolveReleaseFooter({ target: 'browser', developmentBuild: false, source, })).resolves.toEqual({ platform: 'Website', version: '4.1.5', build: '2026082904', })
declarations.manualRationale: Browser production selects Website and exact release-candidate ID; local development bypasses that released identity.

declarations.title: uses installed %s package metadata
assertions: expect(resolveReleaseFooter({ target, developmentBuild: false, source, metadata: { metadata: async () => ({ hostKind: 'mobile-native', applicationId: 'com.blindsidedgames.idledysonswarm', applicationVersion: '4.1.6', applicationBuild: build, supportsNativeFilesystemMigration: true, }), }, })).resolves.toEqual({ platform, version: '4.1.6', build, })
declarations.manualRationale: Android and iOS installed metadata override packaged version/build using their host labels; fallback timing tests cannot establish both successful host formats.

declarations.title: labels local Electron development as Dev
assertions: expect(resolveReleaseFooter({ target: 'electron', developmentBuild: true, source, metadata: desktopMetadata(), })).resolves.toEqual({ platform: 'Dev', version: '4.1.5', build: 'local', })
declarations.manualRationale: Electron development must ignore otherwise available packaged native metadata and report Dev/local; browser development uses a separate target branch.

declarations.title: labels generic production Electron packages as Desktop
assertions: expect(resolveReleaseFooter({ target: 'electron', developmentBuild: false, source, metadata: desktopMetadata(), desktopDistribution: desktopDistributionFromBuildValue(undefined), })).resolves.toEqual({ platform: 'Desktop', version: '4.1.6', build: '2026083001', })
declarations.manualRationale: Unspecified desktop distribution remains Desktop with installed metadata; explicit Steam path does not detect accidental default branding as Steam.

declarations.title: labels Electron as Steam only for an explicit Steam build
assertions: expect(resolveReleaseFooter({ target: 'electron', developmentBuild: false, source, metadata: desktopMetadata(), desktopDistribution: desktopDistributionFromBuildValue('steam'), })).resolves.toEqual({ platform: 'Steam', version: '4.1.6', build: '2026083001', })
declarations.manualRationale: Only explicit steam distribution yields Steam label; generic Electron and invalid-value rejection cover different inputs.

declarations.title: rejects invalid desktop distribution build values
assertions: expect(() => desktopDistributionFromBuildValue('store')) .toThrow('Desktop distribution must be desktop or steam.')
declarations.manualRationale: Invalid desktop distribution value must throw rather than default; valid desktop/Steam footer scenarios never pass malformed build configuration.

declarations.title: uses mobile metadata that succeeds before the two-second deadline
declarations.manualRationale: Delayed metadata at deadline minus one millisecond must win over fallback; immediate metadata and timeout-at-deadline checks do not establish the timing boundary.

declarations.title: continues with packaged metadata at the two-second deadline
declarations.manualRationale: Never-resolving metadata must stay pending until exact deadline, then use iOS fallback and emit one timeout classification; rejected promise has a distinct failure path.

declarations.title: records rejection and formats the checked-in iOS fallback
assertions: expect(resolveReleaseFooter({ target: 'ios', developmentBuild: false, source, metadata: { metadata: async () => { throw new Error('unavailable') }, }, onMetadataLookupFailure: (failure) => failures.push(failure), })).resolves.toEqual({ platform: 'iOS', version: '4.1.5', build: '2608.29.04', })
declarations.manualRationale: Rejected metadata promise must produce iOS-format fallback and rejected diagnostic rather than timeout; no successful or hanging-provider case proves that classification.

declarations.title: uses the embedded native override after metadata timeout
declarations.manualRationale: Native packaged override must survive timeout on Android; default release-source timeout does not cover overridden candidate embedding.

declarations.title: uses the embedded native override after metadata rejection
assertions: expect(resolveReleaseFooter({ target: 'ios', developmentBuild: false, source: overriddenNativeSource, metadata: { metadata: async () => { throw new Error('unavailable') }, }, })).resolves.toEqual({ platform: 'iOS', version: '4.1.5', build: '2608.30.07', })
declarations.manualRationale: Native packaged override must survive rejection and iOS numeric build formatting; Android override timeout differs in both failure branch and platform encoding.

declarations.title: ignores metadata that resolves after startup used the fallback
declarations.manualRationale: Resolving native metadata after fallback must not replace the result or emit another diagnostic; a permanently hanging provider cannot exercise late completion.

declarations.title: exposes exactly Unity’s five canonical product identifiers
assertions: expect(STORE_PRODUCT_IDS).toEqual({ tipTier1: 'ids.tiptier1', tipTier2: 'ids.tiptier2', tipTier3: 'ids.tiptier3', developerOptions: 'ids.devoptions', doubleInfinityPoints: 'ids.doubleip', })
declarations.manualRationale: Exact canonical product list and named ID mapping protect externally registered billing identifiers; adapter product-length assertions do not verify those immutable IDs.

declarations.title: keeps the browser release foundation provider-free and inert
assertions: expect(services.entitlements.readOwnership()).resolves.toEqual({ doubleInfinityPoints: false, developerOptions: false, supporterCatGallery: false, })
expect(services.store.products()).resolves.toEqual( CANONICAL_STORE_PRODUCTS.map((product) => ({ productId: product.id, localizedPrice: null, available: false, })), )
expect( services.diagnostics.export({ fileName: 'diagnostics.json', payload: { phase: 'idle', code: 'none' }, }), ).resolves.toEqual({ exported: false, code: 'export-unavailable' })
declarations.manualRationale: Constructs the actual browser service graph and checks metadata, no migration, empty entitlements, unavailable pricing/purchases/restore and diagnostics. This is the composition witness for removal of the standalone no-op adapter test.

declarations.title: pairs the development Store adapter with its in-memory entitlement authority
declarations.manualRationale: Development composition must expose availability and use the same store/entitlement object; production inert defaults do not cover this intentionally separate graph.

declarations.title: does not let shared-save claims grant Double IP or Developer Options
assertions: expect(access).toEqual({ doubleInfinityPoints: false, developerOptions: false, supporterCatGallery: false, supporterCatGalleryAccess: false, developerOptionsSource: 'none', ignoredSharedSaveClaims: { doubleInfinityPoints: true, developerOptions: true, }, })
declarations.manualRationale: Unowned host plus true shared-save claims must still deny durable purchases while reporting ignored claims; positive entitlement tests do not establish this trust boundary.

declarations.title: keeps the in-game Developer Options path explicit but local
assertions: expect(access).toMatchObject({ doubleInfinityPoints: false, developerOptions: true, developerOptionsSource: 'local-in-game-progression', })
declarations.manualRationale: Local in-game Developer Options purchase enables options without host ownership and reports its distinct source; host-store and rejected-save-claim paths cannot replace it.

declarations.title: allows only host ownership to grant durable store entitlements
assertions: expect(access).toMatchObject({ doubleInfinityPoints: true, developerOptions: true, developerOptionsSource: 'host-store', })
declarations.manualRationale: Host-owned Double IP and options must grant access and report host-store source; negative imported claims and local progression are different authorities.

declarations.title: keeps individual no-op adapters testable without a host SDK
assertions: expect(new NoopEntitlementAuthority().readOwnership()).resolves.toEqual({ doubleInfinityPoints: false, developerOptions: false, supporterCatGallery: false, })
expect( new NoopDiagnosticsExporter().export({ fileName: 'diagnostics.json', payload: { phase: 'idle', code: 'none' }, }), ).resolves.toEqual({ exported: false, code: 'export-unavailable' })
declarations.manualRationale: Standalone no-op adapter expectations are already exercised through actual production browser service construction by the provider-free/inert test, including empty entitlement and unavailable purchase/restore behavior. Factory coverage is stronger than direct adapter instantiation.

declarations.title: file export is available for Android and desktop, including desktop web
declarations.manualRationale: Positive host/user-agent combinations distinguish Android native/web and zero-touch desktop web. Negative iOS cases cannot catch export accidentally disabled everywhere.

declarations.title: file export is hidden on iOS native, iPhone web and iPad desktop-mode web
declarations.manualRationale: Negative native iOS, iPhone browser and touch-enabled Macintosh (iPad desktop mode) cases cover three capability exclusions not established by allowed desktop export.

declarations.title: survives arbitrary wall-clock jumps and timer absence
declarations.manualRationale: Fake wall-clock jumps and setInterval spy prove native authority has no expiring browser lease or renewal timer; merely awaiting a slow startup does not cover clock-independent signal fields.

declarations.title: keeps a native startup authoritative beyond the browser 15-second lease window
declarations.manualRationale: Keeps an operation pending while fake timers advance 60 seconds, proving in-flight native startup survives the browser lease window. Immediate post-clock-jump work does not exercise an admitted pending operation.

declarations.title: cancels synchronously, drains admitted work, and rejects its late result
declarations.manualRationale: Gated operation and shutdown assert synchronous cancellation, delayed draining and rejection of its late result. Release-after-idle tests cannot establish the in-flight shutdown fence.

declarations.title: rejects stale operations and all work after terminal release
declarations.manualRationale: Terminal release must forbid reacquisition and new authoritative work and expose released state; the cancellation tests concern work admitted before shutdown.

declarations.title: cancels an acquisition that settles after shutdown begins
declarations.manualRationale: Acquire and shutdown race before acquisition settles must reject it, followed by a fresh authority successfully starting generation one. Pending-operation draining does not cover pending acquisition.

declarations.title: corrupt-header download recovers a real backup with %s conflict choice and preserves both sources
assertions: expect(await readFile(join(f.cloud.localDirectory, 'downloads', downloads[0]), 'utf8')).toBe('damaged header and payload')
declarations.manualRationale: Both choices recover a corrupt downloaded header via a real backup while preserving original download and conflict bytes, consuming acknowledgment, and selecting the correct durable timestamp. Unit mocks cannot prove these filesystem preservation outcomes.

declarations.title: interrupted canonical replacement retains old current and retries the downloaded save after restart
declarations.manualRationale: Injects atomic rename failure, proves old current bytes remain and remote stays readable, then retries successfully; happy-path recovery cannot prove commit-before-ack safety or restart retry.

declarations.title: account change prevents file publication and acknowledgement
declarations.manualRationale: After publication, switching account denies both publish and acknowledge while preserving current bytes. Host tests of publication alone do not witness the acknowledgment identity fence.

declarations.title: unreadable downloaded primary permits local play but disables Cloud publication
declarations.manualRationale: A directory at the remote-file path forces a real read failure: local startup continues but Cloud publication disables and the directory survives; mocked read rejection lacks this host state check.

declarations.title: future-version backup stops downgrade recovery and leaves all files untouched
declarations.manualRationale: Future first backup ahead of a valid older backup must stop recovery and retain remote bytes with no local save, preventing a silent downgrade that corrupt-backup skipping would miss.

declarations.title: healthy checkpoints transferred in both directions load as Cloud saves, not backup recovery
declarations.manualRationale: Alternating real Cloud files across two profiles verifies normalization, source classification and no spurious conflict prompts over three syncs; one-way primary preparation lacks prior-ack state.

declarations.title: independent local progress after a successful sync still requires a preserved conflict choice
declarations.manualRationale: After prior successful sync, independent changed local and remote timestamps must prompt and archive exact local bytes; initial corrupt-download conflicts lack the prior handled fingerprint.

declarations.title: ordinary account launches have no offline prompt and keep their existing root
declarations.manualRationale: Account-only launch with no offline save must retain its root without prompting; all recovery tests create offline progress first.

declarations.title: offline progress is copied into the account, survives restart and preserves both original profiles
declarations.manualRationale: Offline adoption copies save, journal and backup to an account-specific new root, preserves both original profiles and persists selection across a later save/restart. No other case establishes the full successful copy contract.

declarations.title: keeping the account dismisses only this offline snapshot; deferring asks again
declarations.manualRationale: Exercises later versus account choices over repeated calls and a changed offline fingerprint, proving deferral repeats while explicit dismissal applies only to one snapshot.

declarations.title: another account must make its own explicit choice and never receives the first account profile
declarations.manualRationale: A second account must independently choose and cannot inherit first-account selected root; same-account restart tests cannot cover cross-account isolation.

declarations.title: an interrupted selection leaves originals intact and can retry without trusting a partial copy
declarations.manualRationale: Forces selection-record write failure after choice using a directory at the path, verifies originals intact, and retries to durable selection; partial-copy seed test has no failing actual selection write.

declarations.title: identity changes during the choice abort recovery before selection is saved
declarations.manualRationale: Changes identity during choice and asserts no selection file is written; post-selection account-isolation checks do not cover the asynchronous prompt race.

declarations.title: linked offline files and missing selected roots fail closed
declarations.manualRationale: Deleted selected root and symlinked source are distinct fail-closed inputs; verifies unsafe source fails before prompt. Normal copy tests cannot replace path integrity coverage.

declarations.title: recovered offline progress uses normal Cloud conflict resolution: %s
declarations.manualRationale: Both Cloud choices after offline adoption must use ordinary conflict resolution against the adopted root, preserve offline original, and commit the chosen timestamp; standalone Cloud recovery starts from a different root-selection pipeline.

declarations.title: offline preferences alone do not offer an empty profile over an account save
declarations.manualRationale: A policy/preferences file without gameplay save must not trigger offering an empty offline profile; ordinary empty-directory startup does not exercise misleading non-save artifacts.

declarations.title: an uncommitted partial copy is ignored when retrying from the durable old selection
declarations.manualRationale: Preseeds durable null selection plus uncommitted interrupted copy and verifies selection uses a fresh valid root, preventing partial-copy reuse not established by a caught write failure alone.

declarations.title: losing a committed selection cannot silently reopen the older account profile
declarations.manualRationale: Deletes a previously committed selection record and expects fail-closed instead of silently reverting to old account root; missing selected directory is a different persisted-state defect.

declarations.title: uses development commerce only in a development build
declarations.manualRationale: uses development commerce only in a development build. Development versus production environment/mode combinations and compile-time DEV source guard cover separate selection and bundle wiring obligations.

declarations.title: retains an explicit local path to the real Stripe adapter
declarations.manualRationale: retains an explicit local path to the real Stripe adapter. Development versus production environment/mode combinations and compile-time DEV source guard cover separate selection and bundle wiring obligations.

declarations.title: selects Stripe whenever the build is not development
declarations.manualRationale: selects Stripe whenever the build is not development. Development versus production environment/mode combinations and compile-time DEV source guard cover separate selection and bundle wiring obligations.

declarations.title: places the fake selection behind Vite’s compile-time DEV guard
declarations.manualRationale: places the fake selection behind Vite’s compile-time DEV guard. Development versus production environment/mode combinations and compile-time DEV source guard cover separate selection and bundle wiring obligations.

declarations.title: rejects absent and non-callable promotion capabilities
declarations.manualRationale: Capability detector must reject undefined, missing method and boolean method; native happy-path promotion never supplies malformed authority and cannot catch unsafe duck typing.

declarations.title: retains the exact host authority when promotion is callable
declarations.manualRationale: Callable authority must retain exact object identity, preserving host method receiver and ownership; absent/non-callable rejection cannot establish positive capability recognition.

declarations.title: accepts a historical lowercase envelope without changing its payload semantics
declarations.manualRationale: Lowercase historical IDB1 prefix must decode identically to uppercase payload; all ordinary fixtures use uppercase and cannot prove case compatibility.

declarations.title: decodes the canonical schema 8 fixture and preserves its sentinels
declarations.manualRationale: Schema08 Odin decoding verifies root type, dates, exact money, bigint IP, research migration keys and full byte consumption; migration tests normalize source and could conceal decoder representation errors.

declarations.title: unwraps the Odin document before repository migration
declarations.manualRationale: Root convenience API must unwrap Odin envelope and omit root/binaryBytes wrapper fields; raw decode assertions target document shape rather than repository input shape.

declarations.title: allocates only the advertised output for a normal compressed save
declarations.manualRationale: Injected allocation seam records exactly one advertised-size buffer below 8MiB for normal compressed input; successful decode alone would permit oversized memory allocation regression.

declarations.title: decodes historical fixture %s at schema %i
declarations.manualRationale: Three historical support payloads span schema11, schema0 and schema10 with distinct Odin encodings and must consume all bytes; canonical schema08 fixture is not a format-equivalent replacement.

declarations.title: rejects malformed base64 without returning partial state
declarations.manualRationale: Malformed base64 must throw before returning partial state; valid fixture hashes and compressed-integrity tests do not exercise base64 lexical rejection.

declarations.title: accepts a historical lowercase IDB1 envelope through the shared import pipeline
declarations.manualRationale: Lowercase historical IDB1 goes through format dispatch, migration to current schema and manual lifecycle reset; raw lowercase decoder test stops before import classification and preparation.

declarations.title: retains every top-level field classified as a presentation preference
declarations.manualRationale: Every mapping-manifest top-level presentation field must appear in receiver-preference retention list; hand-picked preference values cannot catch adding a new classified field without updating import policy.

declarations.title: manual shared import consumes remote lifecycle time but preserves its stored bank
assertions: expect(imported).toMatchObject({ dateQuitString: '', lastSuccessfulLoadUtc: '2026-07-29T05:00:00Z', offlineTime: 45, futureValue: { retained: true }, })
declarations.manualRationale: Prepared compressed manual import clears remote quit time while retaining bank45 and unknown future object; direct PreparedSave import test bypasses text dispatch/deserialize.

declarations.title: round-trips a 128-day stored-time bank and capacity without capping them
declarations.manualRationale: Compressed import preserves 128-day available bank and capacity, preventing accidental gameplay cap in portability preparation; numeric repair tests bypass shared import context.

declarations.title: manual export and import preserve a universe designation beyond the discrete ceiling
declarations.manualRationale: Universe designation above signed discrete ceiling survives actual manual text import unchanged; frontend projection proves display semantics but not codec/migration preservation.

declarations.title: does not accept device entitlement claims from a shared Web save
declarations.manualRationale: Untrusted shared Web payload with all paid/debug/cheater/tab claims and retirement proofs must clear authority fields including packed bits; existing receiver-owned options tests intentionally retain some fields.

declarations.title: preserves only the receiving installation retirement proof
declarations.manualRationale: Retirement proof must come from receiver pair rather than sender revision/hash, preserving installation ownership of consumed journal evidence; all-proof-stripped case lacks a valid receiver pair.

declarations.title: strips an incomplete receiving retirement proof pair
declarations.manualRationale: Incomplete receiver proof with invalid hash must clear both fields, preventing partial trust despite valid revision; valid-pair retention does not validate malformed evidence.

declarations.title: retains receiving-device presentation preferences on manual imports
assertions: expect(imported).toMatchObject({ globalMute: true, screensaverEnabled: true, hidePurchased: true, numberFormatting: 3, skillsBuyOnTap: true, frameRate: 120, botsButtonToggle: true, storyButtonToggle: true, bots: 42, })
declarations.manualRationale: Manual text import takes gameplay bots from sender but eight local presentation values from receiver; nested navigation-specific helper test does not cover this broader preference list.

declarations.title: manual shared import keeps only the receiving local Developer Options unlock
declarations.manualRationale: Receiver local Developer Options/cheater/tab unlock survives while sender Double IP does not; no-receiver claim stripping would incorrectly deny an already-purchased local unlock.

declarations.title: manual shared import cannot introduce a sender Developer Options claim
declarations.manualRationale: Explicit unowned receiver cannot gain sender Developer Options despite both flags true remotely; absent receiver and owned receiver tests cover different retention branches.

declarations.title: automatic same-device migration preserves Unity evidence and quit time for one startup grant
assertions: expect(imported).toMatchObject({ dateQuitString: '2026-07-29T04:00:00Z', offlineTime: 30, doubleIp: true, debugOptions: true, debugEverEnabled: true, })
declarations.manualRationale: Automatic same-device context preserves quit time, bank and genuine Unity purchase/debug evidence in compressed Web envelope; manual context must deliberately strip them.

declarations.title: automatic context preserves the genuine Unity quit timestamp for startup consumption
declarations.manualRationale: Automatic import of real schema08 Odin artifact retains its legacy-formatted quit timestamp, a source-format/date-parser boundary absent in synthetic ISO Web envelope.

declarations.title: transitional Web upgrade preserves local lifecycle and entitlement state
assertions: expect(imported).toMatchObject({ dateQuitString: '2026-07-29T04:00:00Z', debugOptions: true, debugEverEnabled: true, })
declarations.manualRationale: Transitional uncompressed Web upgrade retains local lifecycle/debug fields rather than applying manual-share reset; automatic Unity migration has a different context discriminator.

declarations.title: accepts shipped Unity IDB1 saves through the same migration pipeline
declarations.manualRationale: Uppercase shipped Odin save passes manual import migration and resets lifecycle to receiver timestamp; automatic Odin import intentionally keeps remote quit, and lowercase case protects a separate accepted envelope spelling.

declarations.title: accepts compressed Web saves through the same preparation pipeline
assertions: expect(imported).toMatchObject({ dateQuitString: '', lastSuccessfulLoadUtc: '2026-07-29T05:00:00Z', futureValue: { retained: true }, })
declarations.manualRationale: Raw compressed schema12 Web save, without pre-preparing to current schema, migrates during import and retains unknown fields. Earlier prepared-Web case serializes current schema and therefore bypasses old-schema text migration.

declarations.title: rejects text outside both supported save envelopes
declarations.manualRationale: Unsupported non-envelope text must reject instead of creating a default save; valid supported envelope cases do not establish format fail-closed behavior.

declarations.title: retains modern receiver visibility and imported per-save discovery without portable size
assertions: expect(retained.bottomNavigationPreferences).toEqual({ version: 1, visibility: { story: true, wiki: true, statistics: true, settings: true, }, routeDiscovery: { knownRoutes: ['research'], unvisitedRoutes: ['research'], }, })

expect(hydrateGameState(PreparedSave.fromDecoded(retained)).state.meta) .toMatchObject({ navigationVisibility: { story: true, wiki: true, statistics: true, settings: true, }, navigationRouteDiscovery: { knownRoutes: ['research'], unvisitedRoutes: ['research'], }, })
declarations.manualRationale: Modern receiver visibility overrides sender while imported per-save discovery survives and size is stripped; asserts both portable representation and hydrated metadata to protect preference ownership across mapping.

declarations.title: derives nested receiver visibility from legacy toggles instead of the sender
assertions: expect(hydrateGameState(PreparedSave.fromDecoded(retained)).state.meta .navigationVisibility).toMatchObject({ story: true, wiki: false, statistics: true, settings: true, })
declarations.manualRationale: Receiver with only legacy toggles must derive modern visibility instead of importing sender preferences; modern receiver scenario never runs legacy fallback translation.

declarations.title: preserves every fixture byte-for-byte against its manifest
declarations.manualRationale: Hashes every baseline/support fixture byte-for-byte against manifests, preventing accidental mutation of regression evidence even when decoder still accepts it.

declarations.title: preserves schema-7 raw sentinels as inspectable historical evidence
declarations.manualRationale: Raw schema07 fixture retains known schema/date/first-Infinity meaning independent of manifest hash update; this semantic sentinel protects provenance of the historical fixture used as migration evidence.

declarations.title: rejects malformed support case 04 without mutating receiving state
assertions: expect(() => prepareImportedSaveText( malformed, '2026-08-21T00:00:00Z', undefined, { kind: 'manual-shared-import', importedAtUtc: '2026-08-21T00:00:00Z', }, receiving, ), ).toThrow()
declarations.manualRationale: Actual malformed cross-platform support payload must reject manual import without mutating receiving state; synthetic corrupt base64 tests do not exercise this historical payload and receiver-preference path.

declarations.title: migrates $name to the publishable schema
declarations.manualRationale: Each checked-in parity fixture migrates its distinct source schema to current while preserving original source and matching independent expected subset; support saves represent real historical structures rather than arbitrary repeated inputs.

declarations.title: ports legacy identifiers, sparse facilities, avocado and parity repairs
assertions: expect(avocado).toMatchObject({ unlocked: true, infinityPoints: 12, influence: 2, strangeMatter: 3, overflowMultiplier: 4, })
declarations.manualRationale: Synthetic schema0 combines legacy skill/research IDs, sparse facility arrays, Avocado fields, secret-step clamp and Dream parity repairs, asserting their exact conversions absent from generic current-schema roundtrip.

declarations.title: repairs invalid numeric state before validation
declarations.manualRationale: Invalid numeric fields exercise infinity/NaN saturation, worker progress modulo, research floor and both distribution clamps before validation, with repair evidence and cheater marking.

declarations.title: preserves finite stored-time capacity without a gameplay cap
declarations.manualRationale: Finite 128-day bank/capacity remains unchanged without cheater marking or capacity repair entry; import roundtrip checks values only and cannot witness false repair reporting.

declarations.title: repairs positive-infinite stored-time capacity to the finite numeric ceiling
declarations.manualRationale: Positive-infinite bank and capacity saturate to MAX_VALUE and mark cheater; prior mixed numeric case uses NaN capacity that instead restores default.

declarations.title: migrates schema-12 Influence and Strange Matter carriers to finite doubles
declarations.manualRationale: Schema12 Influence/Strange Matter bigint/string carriers across resources, Avocado and every statistics window migrate to finite doubles, saturate overflow, initialize batch counters and preserve source types.

declarations.title: migrates schema 13 without rerunning its resource migration
declarations.manualRationale: Schema13 already-continuous MAX_VALUE resources must skip earlier migration step; schema12 conversion test cannot detect double-running retired migration on newer data.

declarations.title: copies the legacy live queue into only the selected preset once
declarations.manualRationale: Legacy selected slot three receives live desired queue once while other four stay independent; rerunning at current schema with divergent live queue must not overwrite saved slot.

declarations.title: preserves schema-12 skill preset order during the schema-13 resource migration
declarations.manualRationale: Schema12 unselected preset preserves explicit legacy priority order through resource migration; selected-slot migration intentionally replaces a different slot and cannot prove this order.

declarations.title: validator rejects future schema and non-finite prepared state
assertions: expect(validatePreparedSave(migrated.save, 17)).toEqual({ valid: false, error: 'saveSettings.dysonVerseSaveData.dysonVerseInfinityData.money contains a non-finite number.', })
declarations.manualRationale: Future schema refuses migration, and manually corrupted prepared NaN returns exact path-specific validator error; repair-before-validation tests would normalize the defect instead of rejecting it.

declarations.title: bounds old finite progress and preserves existing rewards without triggering a reset (rewarded=%s)
declarations.manualRationale: Both old rewarded and unrewarded MAX_VALUE states migrate to capped pending voluntary choice without a new reward or unrelated currency reset, preserving source graph and repair classification; low-bot states take a different migration branch.

declarations.title: does not turn a historical reward latch below the new boundary into fresh reset eligibility
declarations.manualRationale: Historical rewarded latch below current boundary must clear without creating eligibility/points; cap-state migration intentionally makes eligibility pending.

declarations.title: repairs invalid bots %s without eligibility or points
declarations.manualRationale: NaN, positive/negative infinity and negative bots repair to zero with no Overflow eligibility/reward. Distinct invalid categories protect repair behavior rather than selecting arbitrary finite samples.

declarations.title: round-trips a current pending choice and whole point balance through portable serialization
declarations.manualRationale: Current pending choice with seventeen whole Overflow points roundtrips while bots remain below cap, verifying durable eligibility independent of recomputation from current quantity.

declarations.title: rejects an invalid new point balance %s
declarations.manualRationale: New Overflow balance rejects negative bigint, fractional number and one-over-int64 value; these are separate type/range invariants for the new durable field.

declarations.title: establishes a fresh lifecycle baseline without losing durable state
assertions: expect(imported.copyValidatedState()).toMatchObject({ dateQuitString: '', lastSuccessfulLoadUtc: '2026-07-29T04:05:06Z', offlineTime: 12_345, offlineTimeUsedThisInfinity: 67, futureContainer: { durableValue: 89n, }, })
declarations.manualRationale: Importing an already-prepared save resets sender lifecycle fields while retaining bank, used-time and unknown bigint container without mutating source; text import tests do not assert this full PreparedSave API contract.

declarations.title: rejects an empty local import timestamp
assertions: expect(() => prepareImportedSave(source, ' ')).toThrow( 'Import timestamp must not be empty.', )
declarations.manualRationale: Whitespace-only receiver import timestamp rejects at preparation boundary; valid timestamp reset test would not detect accepting an empty local baseline.

declarations.title: preserves the reported 64-to-128-day upgrade through export, import, checkpoint, and reload
declarations.manualRationale: Reported64day upgrade crosses domain, export/import and repository persistence with empty spent bank.

declarations.title: automatically migrates lowercase IDB1 while retaining the exact recovery source
declarations.manualRationale: Real lowercase transport decoding differs from stub legacy source and preserves exact lowercase bytes.

declarations.title: migrates once, atomically promotes, and preserves the Odin source
declarations.manualRationale: Stub migration asserts exact copy/atomic replace calls and no second promotion.

declarations.title: adopts legacy presentation preferences only after a successful automatic migration commit
declarations.manualRationale: Verified native provenance promotes both presentation preferences once after durable migration.

declarations.title: does not adopt migration-generated defaults when raw Unity preferences are $label
declarations.manualRationale: Absent and string-typed preferences must not promote migration-generated defaults.

declarations.title: preserves an explicit false Unity Research visibility preference
declarations.manualRationale: Explicit false is a valid preference independently of absent/malformed and true.

declarations.title: does not adopt presentation preferences from $label
declarations.manualRationale: Each provenance/path/id mismatch is an independent adoption denial condition.

declarations.title: does not adopt legacy notation when automatic migration fails to commit
declarations.manualRationale: Atomic migration failure must prevent both preference adoptions.

declarations.title: keeps a committed migration when optional notation adoption throws
declarations.manualRationale: Optional notation adopter throws after commit; visibility adoption and migrated save survive.

declarations.title: falls back to a valid recovery candidate when the first legacy file is corrupt
declarations.manualRationale: Corrupt first legacy decoder falls through to next valid candidate.

declarations.title: loads current saves only through migration, repair, and validation
declarations.manualRationale: Current older schema upgrades through PreparedSave without using legacy decoder.

declarations.title: rejects a future-schema current save before publication
declarations.manualRationale: loadCurrent explicitly rejects future schema; migration fallback case targets a different API.

declarations.title: preserves the current save when %s fails
declarations.manualRationale: Write, verification-read and replace failures are different atomic commit stages.

declarations.title: blocks canonical player-save writes by default
assertions: expect( repository.commit( PreparedSave.fromDecoded({ saveVersion: 12 }), 'canonical-player', ), ).rejects.toThrow('disabled until mapping coverage is complete')
declarations.manualRationale: Default canonical-player write gate must reject before any storage mutation; compatibility writes differ.

declarations.title: does not replace current when temporary verification is corrupt
declarations.manualRationale: Corrupt readback rejects before atomic replacement.

declarations.title: rejects a different valid payload returned by temporary read-back
assertions: expect( repository.commit( PreparedSave.fromDecoded({ saveVersion: 12, checkpointMarker: 'candidate', }), ), ).rejects.toThrow('Temporary save verification failed')
declarations.manualRationale: Different valid readback verifies content identity, unlike malformed readback.

declarations.title: does not replace current when the candidate contains a lossy graph value
assertions: expect( repository.commit( PreparedSave.fromDecoded({ saveVersion: 12, unknownForwardField: undefined, }), ), ).rejects.toThrow('undefined')
declarations.manualRationale: Undefined graph value loss must reject while preserving current.

declarations.title: does not replace current when a source object collides with a codec tag
assertions: expect( repository.commit( PreparedSave.fromDecoded({ saveVersion: 12, unknownForwardField: { $bigint: '123' }, }), ), ).rejects.toThrow('reserved codec tags')
declarations.manualRationale: Reserved codec-tag collision is distinct from lossy undefined data.

declarations.title: promotes same-device Unity Double IP evidence only during first migration
assertions: expect(promoted).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ permanentDoubleInfinityPoints: true, platform: 'windows', sourceClass: 'unity-persistent-data-save', opaqueSourceIdentifier: 'canonical-unity', pathClass: 'unity-local-low', saveSchemaVersion: 17, contentSha256: expect.stringMatching(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/), })])

expect.objectContaining({ permanentDoubleInfinityPoints: true, platform: 'windows', sourceClass: 'unity-persistent-data-save', opaqueSourceIdentifier: 'canonical-unity', pathClass: 'unity-local-low', saveSchemaVersion: 17, contentSha256: expect.stringMatching(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/), })
declarations.manualRationale: Verified paid native evidence promotes once with content hash/provenance.

declarations.title: does not invoke purchase promotion without affirmative Unity evidence
declarations.manualRationale: Valid provenance without affirmative purchase does not promote.

declarations.title: never promotes a rediscovered browser import carrying Double IP
declarations.manualRationale: Paid browser import has wrong trust origin and must not promote.

declarations.title: recovers a retained canonical Web export as well as Unity IDB1 text
declarations.manualRationale: Canonical portable retained transport is accepted and source-preserved without Odin decode.

declarations.title: rotates three verified backups before publishing a replacement
declarations.manualRationale: All3 backup slots rotate in order before new current publication.

declarations.title: keeps a valid current save when a transitional backup is damaged
declarations.manualRationale: Typed damaged transitional backup error cannot displace valid current.

declarations.title: ignores an unreadable optional V2 Stored Time policy sidecar
declarations.manualRationale: Optional policy sidecar exists error is ignorable; active job errors in other suite are required.

declarations.title: keeps a valid current save when a transitional backup cannot be represented
declarations.manualRationale: Valid current avoids invoking incompatible transitional recovery callback at all.

declarations.title: does not overlay a historical V2 backup onto an unmarked valid current save
declarations.manualRationale: Historical namespace checkpoint does not overlay unmarked valid current.

declarations.title: does not overlay an unclocked V2 backup onto a valid current-format backup
declarations.manualRationale: Unclocked historical V2 cannot displace valid canonical backup when current is damaged.

declarations.title: uses a recognized active V2 checkpoint over its older current-format backup
declarations.manualRationale: Recognized active V2 does take priority over older canonical backup.

declarations.title: uses a newer V2 slot from the same rotation over its older canonical base
declarations.manualRationale: Newer V2 in same rotation takes priority using older canonical base.

declarations.title: uses a V2 checkpoint in the shared native backup namespace with a retained base
declarations.manualRationale: Native V2 backup recovers through independently retained pre-schema13 base.

declarations.title: recovers a V2 backup from a deterministic base when the current save is absent
declarations.manualRationale: Absent current with V2 backup uses deterministic base factory.

declarations.title: skips an unreadable transitional artifact and recovers an older V2 checkpoint
declarations.manualRationale: I/O unreadable transitional source falls through to older V2 source.

declarations.title: skips an optional backup whose existence cannot be inspected
declarations.manualRationale: Cannot inspect existence of optional backup differs from read failure; older canonical backup recovers.

declarations.title: skips an unreadable retained artifact and recovers an older retained save
declarations.manualRationale: Unreadable retained source falls through within retained source list.

declarations.title: recovers a V2-first player from a deterministic base when no earlier save exists
declarations.manualRationale: V2-first active current uses supplied deterministic base; stub adapter checks injected recovery behavior unlike authentic schema suite.

declarations.title: retains rejected V2 bytes and keeps V2 preferences when a legacy base is overlaid
declarations.manualRationale: V2 overlay wins device preferences over trusted Unity base while rejected V2 bytes retained.

declarations.title: preserves the durable Dyson evaluation snapshot through commit and reload
assertions: expect(hydrateGameState(reloaded!).skillEffectEvaluationSnapshot).toEqual({ panelsPerSecond: 11, panelLifetimeSeconds: 12, scienceMultiplier: 13, rudimentarySingularityProduction: 14, pocketDimensionsProduction: 15, scientificPlanetsProduction: 16, managerAssemblyLineProduction: 17, })
declarations.manualRationale: Seven durable evaluation fields use distinct sentinels across commit/reload.

declarations.title: keeps a valid current save ahead of a readable transitional backup
declarations.manualRationale: Readable valid transitional backup remains secondary to current and untouched.

declarations.title: does not replace current when backup rotation fails
assertions: expect( repository.commit( PreparedSave.fromDecoded({ saveVersion: 12, slot: 'candidate' }), ), ).rejects.toThrow('backup copy failed')
declarations.manualRationale: Backup copy failure prevents replacement, complementing write/read/replace failures.

declarations.title: recovers from a corrupt current save using a valid legacy candidate
declarations.manualRationale: Corrupt current retained while legacy recovery succeeds.

declarations.title: recovers the newest valid Web backup before considering Unity candidates
declarations.manualRationale: Newest valid canonical backup wins before Unity; exact copy/replace calls verify recovery sequence.

declarations.title: recovers an exact source retained by an earlier canonical migration
declarations.manualRationale: Earlier retained canonical migration source recovers unsupported current without altering retained source.

declarations.title: reports the rejected current save instead of masking it with an unrelated legacy failure
assertions: expect(repository.migrateLegacyOnFirstLaunch()).resolves.toEqual({ status: 'current-invalid', error: 'Unsupported web save envelope ids-web-production-v2-checkpoint-v1.', })
declarations.manualRationale: Current error must not be masked by later unrelated invalid legacy decoder.

declarations.title: blocks downgrade recovery when the newest readable backup has a future schema
declarations.manualRationale: Newest future backup blocks older readable downgrade fallback.

declarations.title: does not silently start fresh when every Web backup is invalid
declarations.manualRationale: Only invalid backup prevents fresh startup even without current.

declarations.title: retains a legacy source when only an invalid backup caused the startup error
declarations.manualRationale: Legacy source retention when only backup invalid differs from corrupt current retention.

declarations.title: treats publication failure during valid backup recovery as terminal
assertions: expect(repository.migrateLegacyOnFirstLaunch()).resolves.toMatchObject({ status: 'recovery-write-failed', source: { id: 'web-backup', sourcePath: '/current.backup.1', }, error: 'temporary write failed', })
declarations.manualRationale: Valid backup publication failure is terminal with web-backup source metadata.

declarations.title: stops fallback when the current save has a future schema
declarations.manualRationale: Future current prevents all fallback/copy/replace.

declarations.title: stops on an encountered future legacy candidate
declarations.manualRationale: Future first legacy candidate prevents later valid legacy fallback.

declarations.title: classifies a valid recovery candidate write failure as terminal
assertions: expect(repository.migrateLegacyOnFirstLaunch()).resolves.toMatchObject({ status: 'recovery-write-failed', source: { id: 'legacy' }, error: 'temporary write failed', })
declarations.manualRationale: Valid legacy publication failure is terminal with legacy source metadata.

declarations.title: round-trips bigint and byte arrays without precision loss
declarations.manualRationale: Codec roundtrips max signed bigint and byte array exactly and re-encoding yields identical compressed text; ordinary numeric fields do not exercise tagged precision/binary codecs.

declarations.title: rejects a canonical IDSWEB1 payload with a corrupted gzip checksum
assertions: expect(() => deserializeWebSave( `IDSWEB1:${compressed.toString('base64')}`, )).toThrow(/gzip checksum does not match/u)
declarations.manualRationale: Flips actual gzip CRC trailer and requires checksum-specific rejection, protecting corruption detection beyond valid base64/decompression.

declarations.title: excludes device-local presentation preferences from portable saves
assertions: expect(decoded).toMatchObject({ saveVersion: 12, bots: 42, doubleIp: false, debugOptions: false, debugEverEnabled: false, })
declarations.manualRationale: Shared export strips presentation-local fields, nav size and retirement proof while retaining portable visibility/gameplay and false entitlement defaults; true-claim stripping below exercises separate packed-flag state.

declarations.title: rejects cyclic graphs instead of producing ambiguous persistence
declarations.manualRationale: Cyclic source graph must fail explicitly rather than recur forever or serialize ambiguously; deeply nested acyclic input exercises depth budget instead.

declarations.title: rejects lossy %s values instead of changing durable state
declarations.expression:
test.each([
    ['undefined', undefined],
    ['function', () => undefined],
    ['symbol', Symbol('unsupported')],
    ['date', new Date('2026-08-19T00:00:00Z')],
    ['non-finite number', Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY],
    ['negative zero', -0],
  ])
assertions: expect(() => serializeWebSave({ saveVersion: 12, value })).toThrow( 'Canonical web saves', )
declarations.manualRationale: Undefined/function/symbol/Date/non-finite/negative-zero values are distinct lossy serialization classes that must reject; valid numbers and tagged bigint cannot replace these type boundaries.

declarations.title: rejects sparse arrays and symbol-keyed properties
declarations.manualRationale: Sparse array holes and symbol-keyed properties would silently disappear under JSON, so both structural loss paths must reject separately from explicit undefined/symbol values.

declarations.title: rejects source objects that collide with the reserved %s codec tag
assertions: expect(() => serializeWebSave({ saveVersion: 12, value })).toThrow( 'reserved codec tags', )
declarations.manualRationale: Plain objects colliding with each reserved bigint/bytes tag must reject before ambiguous codec interpretation; roundtrip tags are produced internally and intentionally accepted on decode.

declarations.title: rejects mismatched envelope and state schemas
assertions: expect(() => deserializeWebSave(mismatched)).toThrow( 'does not match state schema', )
declarations.manualRationale: Envelope schema11 with state schema12 must reject inconsistency; unsupported future schema detection does not compare dual version identities.

declarations.title: rejects direct duplicate JSON object keys before they collapse
declarations.manualRationale: Direct duplicate JSON key must reject before parser collapses it, even if duplicate values are identical; ordinary schema validation sees only the collapsed object.

declarations.title: rejects escaped-equivalent duplicate JSON object keys
declarations.manualRationale: Escaped equivalent key (Unicode f in format) must collide after escape normalization; direct duplicate spelling test would pass if parser compared raw key tokens.

declarations.title: enforces the raw JSON entry budget before envelope classification
assertions: expect(() => decodeWebSaveTextBounded(unsupported, { suppliedTextBytes: 8 * 1024 * 1024, decodedPayloadBytes: 8 * 1024 * 1024, inflatedBinaryBytes: 8 * 1024 * 1024, })).toThrow('maximum entry count')
declarations.manualRationale: Unsupported envelope with 250001 entries must fail resource budget before envelope classification; compressed byte/depth limits do not count object entries.

declarations.title: produces stable text regardless of the current wall clock
declarations.manualRationale: Same save encoded under two wall-clock dates yields identical bytes, guarding gzip timestamp nondeterminism; immediate re-encode roundtrip occurs under one clock and cannot expose it.

declarations.title: rejects compressed payloads that are not valid UTF-8 JSON
declarations.manualRationale: Gzip payload with invalid UTF-8 bytes must reject encoding before JSON interpretation; checksum corruption is a different integrity stage.

declarations.title: continues to read transitional uncompressed web envelopes
declarations.manualRationale: Historical uncompressed Web envelope with tagged bigint above int64 remains readable; current serializer always emits compressed form and cannot generate this legacy transport.

declarations.title: keeps repetitive canonical exports compact
declarations.manualRationale: Repetitive 2000-object export remains below1000 characters, establishing compression effectiveness not just codec correctness; this is a compact-export regression contract.

declarations.title: shared exports exclude device-owned Double IP and Developer Options
assertions: expect(decoded).toMatchObject({ doubleIp: false, debugOptions: false, debugEverEnabled: false, hasPackedSettingsFlags: true, dysonVerseSaveData: { dysonVersePrestigeData: { doubleIP: true }, }, })
declarations.manualRationale: Shared export with true device claims clears top-level flags/packed bits while retaining independent legacy gameplay doubleIP field; presentation stripping case begins without true claims or nested gameplay field.

declarations.title: rejects a 1.1 MiB byte field before base64 byte allocation
declarations.manualRationale: Single1.1MiB decoded byte array must reject despite small compressed transport, detecting decompression/tag allocation amplification beyond supplied-size guard.

declarations.title: enforces the decoded-byte budget cumulatively across fields
declarations.manualRationale: Two600k byte arrays exceed budget cumulatively even though each individually fits; single-field oversize check would not detect resetting the counter per field.

declarations.title: bounds nested container reconstruction
declarations.manualRationale: 130 nested arrays reject reconstruction depth despite small payload and valid acyclic source, protecting recursion budget independently of entry or byte limits.

declarations.title: publishes a healthy primary without rewriting it
declarations.manualRationale: Healthy already-normalized primary returns same prepared object without redundant commit; migrated/repaired cases intentionally rewrite before ready.

declarations.title: commits a migrated or repaired primary before ready
declarations.expression:
test.each([
    PreparedSave.fromDecoded({ saveVersion: 8 }),
    PreparedSave.fromDecoded({ saveVersion: 12, offlineTime: -1 }),
  ])
declarations.manualRationale: Older-schema and numeric-repair primary must commit using configured target and publish returned verified save; these are two independent reasons requiresVerifiedCommit can be true.

declarations.title: returns a migrated legacy save only after the repository commit
declarations.manualRationale: Repository-reported migrated legacy save maps to recovered-legacy without a second commit; direct repository migration tests do not cover resolver source classification.

declarations.title: identifies verified Web-backup recovery to the presentation layer
declarations.manualRationale: Verified backup outcome maps to recovered-canonical with exact prepared object, preserving presentation recovery source distinct from legacy or primary.

declarations.title: returns first-run only for the no-artifact repository outcome
declarations.manualRationale: Only no-legacy-save outcome invokes first-run factory and returns its exact prepared result; artifact-bearing invalid cases must remain blocked.

declarations.title: maps $reason to a blocking outcome
declarations.manualRationale: Future-version, invalid current and two recovery-write source shapes map to blocked reasons; legacy source carries bytes while backup source does not, exercising guarded candidate extraction.

declarations.title: blocks when the repaired-primary commit fails
declarations.manualRationale: Repaired primary commit rejection maps exact error to recovery-write-failed and never publishes ready; repository already-reported failure mapping does not execute this commit path.

declarations.title: previews a raw schema-13 export with receiver-owned preferences and round-trips it
assertions: expect(previewRecord).toMatchObject({ dateQuitString: '', lastSuccessfulLoadUtc: '2026-08-30T01:00:00.000Z', globalMute: true, hidePurchased: false, debugEverEnabled: true, debugOptions: true, cheater: true, unlockAllTabs: true, doubleIp: false, })

expect(hydrateGameState(reloaded).state).toMatchObject({ dyson: { money: 12_345 }, timeline: { lastSuspendedAtLegacyText: null, storedTimeAvailableSeconds: 3_600, storedTimeCapacitySeconds: 7_200, processing: { storedTimePreset: 'accurate' }, }, })

expect(reloaded.copyValidatedState()).toMatchObject({ dateQuitString: '', lastSuccessfulLoadUtc: '2026-08-30T01:00:00.000Z', globalMute: true, hidePurchased: false, debugEverEnabled: true, debugOptions: true, cheater: true, unlockAllTabs: true, })
declarations.manualRationale: Pure import uses receiver flags, removes receiver-only gameplay and clears suspension; confirms serialized result without host startup.

declarations.title: confirms a raw schema-13 replacement from blocked startup and reloads it
assertions: expect(application.importSave({ text: future, importedAtUtc: '2026-08-30T02:00:00.000Z', overwriteApproved: true, })).resolves.toMatchObject({ imported: false, committed: false, code: 'APP-IMPORT-INVALID', })
expect(corrupted).toMatchObject({ imported: false, committed: false, code: 'APP-IMPORT-INVALID', })
expect(application.importSave({ text: portableText(state), importedAtUtc: '2026-08-30T02:00:00.000Z', overwriteApproved: true, })).resolves.toMatchObject({ imported: true })
declarations.manualRationale: Application starts from malformed current, rejects future/checksum input without base calls, then backs up and commits valid schema13.

declarations.title: requires approval and rotates an unsupported future current before raw schema-13 recovery
assertions: expect(application.importSave({ text: portableText(state), importedAtUtc: '2026-08-30T03:00:00.000Z', overwriteApproved: false, })).resolves.toMatchObject({ imported: false, committed: false, code: 'APP-IMPORT-OVERWRITE-REQUIRED', })
expect(application.importSave({ text: portableText(state), importedAtUtc: '2026-08-30T03:00:00.000Z', overwriteApproved: true, })).resolves.toMatchObject({ imported: true })
declarations.manualRationale: Unsupported-future current follows overwrite approval gate; differs from malformed current and guards rotation only after approval.

declarations.title: retains decodable receiver-local state during a non-schema blocked rescue import
assertions: expect(application.importSave({ text: portableText(state), importedAtUtc: '2026-08-30T03:30:00.000Z', overwriteApproved: true, })).resolves.toMatchObject({ imported: true })
expect(imported).toMatchObject({ globalMute: true, debugOptions: true, debugEverEnabled: true, cheater: true, unlockAllTabs: true, processingStoredTimePreset: 'accurate', })

expect(hydrateGameState(PreparedSave.fromDecoded(imported)).state) .toMatchObject({ dyson: { money: 11_223 }, timeline: { storedTimeAvailableSeconds: 3_333, storedTimeCapacitySeconds: 4_444, processing: { storedTimePreset: 'accurate' }, }, })
declarations.manualRationale: Storage-failed startup retains decodable receiver flags while importing donor time/gameplay through application API.

declarations.title: keeps blocked browser preview and confirm on receiver-local state without leaking receiver gameplay
assertions: expect(runtime.previewImport({ source: 'paste', text, importedAtUtc: '2026-08-30T03:45:00.000Z', overwriteApproved: true, })).resolves.toMatchObject({ accepted: true, preview: { infinityPoints: 10n }, })
expect(runtime.importSave({ source: 'paste', text, importedAtUtc: '2026-08-30T03:45:00.000Z', overwriteApproved: true, })).resolves.toMatchObject({ imported: true })
expect(imported.copyValidatedState()).toMatchObject({ globalMute: true, debugOptions: true, debugEverEnabled: true, cheater: true, unlockAllTabs: true, processingStoredTimePreset: 'accurate', })

expect(hydrateGameState(imported).state).toMatchObject({ dyson: { money: 11_223 }, infinity: { points: 10n }, timeline: { storedTimeAvailableSeconds: 3_333, storedTimeCapacitySeconds: 4_444, processing: { storedTimePreset: 'accurate' }, }, })
declarations.manualRationale: Browser preview plus confirmation checks 10-point total and receiver-only preferences in forced storage-failed state.

declarations.title: previews, confirms, and reloads a raw schema-13 paste through the browser runtime
assertions: expect(runtime.previewImport({ source: 'paste', text, importedAtUtc: '2026-08-30T04:00:00.000Z', overwriteApproved: true, })).resolves.toMatchObject({ accepted: true, preview: { infinityPoints: 10n }, })
expect(runtime.importSave({ source: 'paste', text, importedAtUtc: '2026-08-30T04:00:00.000Z', overwriteApproved: true, })).resolves.toMatchObject({ imported: true })
declarations.manualRationale: Ready empty browser host paste is shut down and reconstructed to verify durable import.

declarations.title: uses the ready receiver platform state for raw schema-13 file preview and import
assertions: expect(runtime.previewImport({ source: 'file', file, importedAtUtc: '2026-08-30T05:00:00.000Z', overwriteApproved: true, })).resolves.toMatchObject({ accepted: true })
expect(runtime.importSave({ source: 'file', file, importedAtUtc: '2026-08-30T05:00:00.000Z', overwriteApproved: true, })).resolves.toMatchObject({ imported: true })
expect(current.copyValidatedState()).toMatchObject({ globalMute: true, debugOptions: true, debugEverEnabled: true, cheater: true, unlockAllTabs: true, })
declarations.manualRationale: File transport from a ready receiver preserves its local flags; distinct from paste and blocked startup.

declarations.title: recovers a blocked browser runtime from a raw schema-13 paste
assertions: expect(runtime.previewImport({ source: 'paste', text: portableText(state), importedAtUtc: '2026-08-30T06:00:00.000Z', overwriteApproved: true, })).resolves.toMatchObject({ accepted: true })
expect(runtime.importSave({ source: 'paste', text: portableText(state), importedAtUtc: '2026-08-30T06:00:00.000Z', overwriteApproved: true, })).resolves.toMatchObject({ imported: true })
declarations.manualRationale: Malformed-current browser wrapper must publish ready and retain both backup and rejected source.

declarations.title: preserves the $stage limit classification for raw schema-13 preview
declarations.manualRationale: Decoded-payload versus inflated-binary byte limits are separate stages; error classification is the witness.

declarations.title: accepts every released schema-13 authored boundary
declarations.manualRationale: Positive authored boundaries cover complete released ranges; rejecting above-bound values cannot replace acceptance.

declarations.title: rejects released schema-13 invariant violation: %s
declarations.manualRationale: Each mutation changes a different enum, authored bound, relation or required inventory; identical throw assertions do not imply redundancy.

declarations.title: rejects noncanonical schema-13 numeric carrier: %s
declarations.manualRationale: Raw carrier mutations deliberately bypass canonicalization, separating JSON number/decimal/bigint formats and leading/trailing normalization.

declarations.title: rejects numeric enum negative zero before constructing a base
assertions: expect(() => recoverDecodedTransitionalV2PortableSave( decodedPortableEnvelope(state), () => { baseCalls += 1 return base }, )).toThrow(/unsupported enum value/u)
declarations.manualRationale: Direct decoded enum -0 checks no compatibility-base construction; outer checkpoint -0 uses separate parser fields.

declarations.title: rejects outer checkpoint %s negative zero
declarations.expression:
test.each([
    ['revision', (checkpoint: string) =>
      checkpoint.replace('"revision":0', '"revision":-0')],
    ['number formatting', (checkpoint: string) =>
      checkpoint.replace('"numberFormatting":0', '"numberFormatting":-0')],

    [

      bitDecrement(CONTINUOUS_MAXIMUM),

      CONTINUOUS_MAXIMUM - bitDecrement(CONTINUOUS_MAXIMUM),
    ],
